The ref query parameter is appended to BASE_EXPORT_DIR without canonicalization, then written. Values such as ../../... escape the export directory and allow arbitrary file creation or overwrite with sensitive request data.

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

extra.message: The fragment query parameter is concatenated into a Jinja template and rendered. Attackers can inject Jinja expressions, enabling server-side template injection and potential code execution.

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

extra.message: A fixed client-controlled cookie/header value, lead, grants elevated payroll and casework access. This is a hardcoded authorization credential that can be supplied by any caller that reaches the endpoint.
The host query parameter is concatenated into an os.system() command. Shell metacharacters permit arbitrary OS command execution.

cwe: CWE-78: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

extra.message: The caller controls length with no maximum and the endpoint allocates/generates that many random characters. A large value can exhaust CPU and memory.

The endpoint returns the Django settings module and server filesystem export path to callers, exposing internal deployment details.

extra.message: Support agents are only denied billing documents; no check requires the document's organization to have an escalation assigned to that agent. Any support agent who knows a document UUID can download non-billing documents from unrelated organizations.

cwe: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: For support agents, the OR condition includes every document whose organization has any account manager, rather than only organizations with escalations assigned to the requesting agent. This exposes cross-organization documents.

Global search builds an unrestricted User queryset. The support-agent branch restricts organizations, deals, and escalations but never restricts users, so support agents receive matching user records across all organizations.

Account managers may invoke this import, but organization_name is resolved without verifying that the organization is assigned to the requester. The update_or_create call can create or modify customer contacts in any tenant and can overwrite an existing username's profile and role.
Newly imported contacts receive the fixed password changeme123. An account manager can create predictable-password accounts, including in unrelated organizations through this import.

Account managers are allowed to submit DealForm, whose organization field is unrestricted. The view saves the selected organization without checking assignment, allowing cross-tenant deal creation and subsequent owner-based access.
Any non-customer user, including an account manager or support agent, can submit EscalationForm with an arbitrary organization. No organization access check is performed before saving the escalation.
API-key revocation changes state without requiring POST. Django CSRF protection does not protect GET requests, so a malicious page can trigger revocation in a logged-in user's browser.
API-key rotation changes credentials without requiring POST. Django CSRF protection does not protect GET requests, allowing cross-site rotation for a logged-in authorized user.
DEBUG defaults to True when the environment variable is absent. This exposes Django debug behavior in deployments that omit explicit configuration, including detailed error pages and media serving.

A predictable fallback Django SECRET_KEY is embedded in source. The same settings file also embeds fallback PostgreSQL credentials at line 63, allowing forgery of Django-signed data and database compromise if defaults are deployed.
The seed command creates privileged admin, manager, and support accounts with fixed passwords. Running this command in any reachable environment creates publicly guessable privileged credentials.
